passages.text: In my first book, O Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach, until the day He was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles He had chosen.
passages.sermon:
Luke wrote a book to Theophilus.
Luke wrote about Jesus.
Jesus began to do many things.
Jesus began to teach many things.
Jesus did these things until the day He went up to heaven.
Jesus gave instructions to His chosen apostles.
Jesus gave these instructions through the Holy Spirit.
Then Jesus was taken up to heaven.
passages.original: Τὸν μὲν πρῶτον λόγον ἐποιησάμην περὶ πάντων ὦ Θεόφιλε ὧν ἤρξατο ὁ Ἰησοῦς ποιεῖν τε καὶ διδάσκειν ἄχρι ἧς ἡμέρας ἐντειλάμενος τοῖς ἀποστόλοις διὰ Πνεύματος Ἁγίου οὓς ἐξελέξατο ἀνελήμφθη

passages.text: After His suffering, He presented Himself to them with many convincing proofs that He was alive. He appeared to them over a span of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.
passages.sermon:
Jesus suffered and died.
God raised Jesus from the dead.
Jesus showed Himself alive to His chosen apostles.
He gave them many convincing proofs that He was alive.
He appeared to them for forty days.
He spoke to them about the kingdom of God.
passages.original: οἷς καὶ παρέστησεν ἑαυτὸν ζῶντα μετὰ τὸ παθεῖν αὐτὸν ἐν πολλοῖς τεκμηρίοις δι’ ἡμερῶν τεσσεράκοντα ὀπτανόμενος αὐτοῖς καὶ λέγων τὰ περὶ τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: And while they were gathered together, He commanded them: “Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift the Father promised, which you have heard Me discuss.
passages.sermon:
Jesus gathered His chosen apostles together.
He spoke to them directly.
He gave them a command.
He told them, “Do not leave Jerusalem.”
He told them to wait in Jerusalem.
He said, “Wait for the gift the Father promised.”
He reminded them, “You have heard Me talk about this promise.”
passages.original: Καὶ συναλιζόμενος παρήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων μὴ χωρίζεσθαι ἀλλὰ περιμένειν τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ Πατρὸς Ἣν ἠκούσατέ μου

passages.text: For John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
passages.sermon: John baptized people with water.\r\nYou will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.\r\nThis will happen in a few days.
passages.original: ὅτι Ἰωάννης μὲν ἐβάπτισεν ὕδατι ὑμεῖς δὲ ἐν Πνεύματι βαπτισθήσεσθε Ἁγίῳ οὐ μετὰ πολλὰς ταύτας ἡμέρας

passages.text: So when they came together, they asked Him, “Lord, will You at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?”
passages.sermon:
The disciples gathered together with Jesus.
They spoke to Jesus directly.
They asked Him a question.
They said, “Lord, will You restore the kingdom to Israel at this time?”
passages.original: Οἱ μὲν οὖν συνελθόντες ἠρώτων αὐτὸν λέγοντες Κύριε εἰ ἐν τῷ χρόνῳ τούτῳ ἀποκαθιστάνεις τὴν βασιλείαν τῷ Ἰσραήλ

passages.text: Jesus replied, “It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own authority.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to them.
Jesus answered their question.
Jesus said, "You will not know the times.
You will not know the seasons.
The Father has set these times.
The Father has set these seasons.
The Father used His own authority to do this.
You do not have the authority to know them."
passages.original: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς Οὐχ ὑμῶν ἐστιν γνῶναι χρόνους ἢ καιροὺς οὓς ὁ Πατὴρ ἔθετο ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ

passages.text: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
Jesus is the Son of God.
He said, “You will receive power.
The Holy Spirit will come upon you.
You will be My witnesses.
You will speak about Me in Jerusalem.
You will speak about Me in all Judea.
You will speak about Me in Samaria.
You will speak about Me to the ends of the earth.”
passages.original: ἀλλὰ λήμψεσθε δύναμιν ἐπελθόντος τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς καὶ ἔσεσθέ μου μάρτυρες ἔν τε Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ καὶ Σαμαρείᾳ καὶ ἕως ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς

passages.text: After He had said this, they watched as He was taken up, and a cloud hid Him from their sight.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
The disciples watched Him.
Jesus was taken up from them.
A cloud came.
The cloud hid Jesus from their sight.
passages.original: Καὶ ταῦτα εἰπὼν βλεπόντων αὐτῶν ἐπήρθη καὶ νεφέλη ὑπέλαβεν αὐτὸν ἀπὸ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν

passages.text: They were looking intently into the sky as He was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.
passages.sermon:
The disciples watched Jesus go up into the sky.
They looked intently at heaven.
Suddenly, two men appeared beside them.
These men wore white clothes.
The two men stood next to the disciples.
passages.original: καὶ ὡς ἀτενίζοντες ἦσαν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν πορευομένου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνδρες δύο παρειστήκεισαν αὐτοῖς ἐν ἐσθήσεσι λευκαῖς

passages.text: “Men of Galilee,” they said, “why do you stand here looking into the sky? This same Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you have seen Him go into heaven.”
passages.sermon:
Two men stood beside the disciples.
These men wore white clothes.
They spoke to the disciples from Galilee.
They said, “Men of Galilee, why do you stand here looking into the sky?”
Jesus has been taken from you into heaven.
This same Jesus will come back.
He will return in the same way you saw Him go into heaven.
passages.original: οἳ καὶ εἶπαν Ἄνδρες Γαλιλαῖοι τί ἑστήκατε βλέποντες εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν οὗτος ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὁ ἀναλημφθεὶς ἀφ’ ὑμῶν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν οὕτως ἐλεύσεται ὃν τρόπον ἐθεάσασθε αὐτὸν πορευόμενον εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν

passages.text: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, which is near the city, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
passages.sermon:
The disciples had just seen Jesus ascend into heaven.
They stood on the Mount of Olives.
The Mount of Olives is close to Jerusalem.
It is about a Sabbath day’s walk from the city.
Then the disciples left the Mount of Olives.
They returned to Jerusalem.
passages.original: Τότε ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἀπὸ ὄρους τοῦ καλουμένου Ἐλαιῶνος ὅ ἐστιν ἐγγὺς Ἰερουσαλὴμ σαββάτου ἔχον ὁδόν

passages.text: When they arrived, they went to the upper room where they were staying: Peter and John, James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James.
passages.sermon:
The disciples arrived in Jerusalem.
They went to the upper room.
They were staying there.
Peter was there.
John was there.
James was there.
Andrew was there.
Philip was there.
Thomas was there.
Bartholomew was there.
Matthew was there.
James, the son of Alphaeus, was there.
Simon the Zealot was there.
Judas, the son of James, was there.
passages.original: καὶ ὅτε εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὸ ὑπερῷον ἀνέβησαν οὗ ἦσαν καταμένοντες ὅ τε Πέτρος καὶ Ἰωάννης καὶ Ἰάκωβος καὶ Ἀνδρέας Φίλιππος καὶ Θωμᾶς Βαρθολομαῖος καὶ Μαθθαῖος Ἰάκωβος Ἁλφαίου καὶ Σίμων ὁ Ζηλωτὴς καὶ Ἰούδας Ἰακώβου

passages.text: With one accord they all continued in prayer, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers.
passages.sermon:
The disciples stayed together in Jerusalem.
They all prayed together with one purpose.
The women joined them in prayer.
Mary, the mother of Jesus, was with them.
The brothers of Jesus were also there.
passages.original: οὗτοι πάντες ἦσαν προσκαρτεροῦντες ὁμοθυμαδὸν τῇ προσευχῇ σὺν γυναιξὶν καὶ Μαριὰμ τῇ μητρὶ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ σὺν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ

passages.text: In those days Peter stood up among the brothers (a gathering of about a hundred and twenty) and said, “Brothers, the Scripture had to be fulfilled which the Holy Spirit foretold through the mouth of David concerning Judas, who became a guide for those who arrested Jesus.
passages.sermon:
Peter was one of the twelve apostles of Jesus.
In those days, Peter stood up among the believers.
There were about one hundred and twenty people gathered together.
Peter spoke to them.
He said, “Brothers, the Scripture had to be fulfilled.
The Holy Spirit spoke this Scripture beforehand through the mouth of David.
The Scripture spoke about Judas.
Judas became a guide for those who arrested Jesus.”
passages.original: Καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις ἀναστὰς Πέτρος ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἀδελφῶν εἶπεν ἦν τε ὄχλος ὀνομάτων ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ὡσεὶ ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί ἔδει πληρωθῆναι τὴν γραφὴν ἣν προεῖπεν τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον διὰ στόματος Δαυὶδ περὶ Ἰούδα τοῦ γενομένου ὁδηγοῦ τοῖς συλλαβοῦσιν Ἰησοῦν

passages.text: He was one of our number and shared in this ministry.”
passages.sermon:
Judas was one of us.
He belonged to our group.
He received a share in this ministry.
He took part in the work we were given.
passages.original: ὅτι κατηριθμημένος ἦν ἐν ἡμῖν καὶ ἔλαχεν τὸν κλῆρον τῆς διακονίας ταύτης

passages.text: (Now with the reward for his wickedness Judas bought a field; there he fell headlong and burst open in the middle, and all his intestines spilled out.
passages.sermon:
Judas received a reward for his wickedness.
Judas used this reward to buy a field.
Judas went to this field.
Judas fell headfirst in the field.
His body burst open in the middle.
All his intestines spilled out.
passages.original: Οὗτος μὲν οὖν ἐκτήσατο χωρίον ἐκ μισθοῦ τῆς ἀδικίας καὶ πρηνὴς γενόμενος ἐλάκησεν μέσος καὶ ἐξεχύθη πάντα τὰ σπλάγχνα αὐτοῦ

passages.text: This became known to all who lived in Jerusalem, so they called that field in their own language Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood.)
passages.sermon:
Everyone who lived in Jerusalem heard about this.
They learned what happened.
They gave the field a name in their own language.
They called it Akeldama.
Akeldama means Field of Blood.
passages.original: καὶ γνωστὸν ἐγένετο πᾶσι τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Ἰερουσαλήμ ὥστε κληθῆναι τὸ χωρίον ἐκεῖνο τῇ ἰδίᾳ διαλέκτῳ αὐτῶν Ἁκελδαμάχ τοῦτ’ ἔστιν Χωρίον αἵματος

passages.text: “For it is written in the book of Psalms: ‘May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it,’ and, ‘May another take his position.’
passages.sermon:
The book of Psalms contains these words.
It says, “May his place become deserted.”
No one should live there.
It also says, “May another take his position.”
passages.original: Γέγραπται γὰρ ἐν βίβλῳ Ψαλμῶν Γενηθήτω ἡ ἔπαυλις αὐτοῦ ἔρημος καὶ μὴ ἔστω ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν αὐτῇ Καί Τὴν ἐπισκοπὴν αὐτοῦ λαβέτω ἕτερος

passages.text: Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have accompanied us the whole time the Lord Jesus went in and out among us, beginning from John’s baptism until the day Jesus was taken up from us. For one of these must become a witness with us of His resurrection.”
passages.sermon:
We must choose one man from among those who have been with us the whole time.
These men were with us while the Lord Jesus lived among us.
Jesus went in and out among us.
This began at the time of John’s baptism.
It continued until the day Jesus was taken up from us.
One of these men must join us as a witness.
He must testify with us about Jesus’ resurrection.
passages.original: Δεῖ οὖν τῶν συνελθόντων ἡμῖν ἀνδρῶν ἐν παντὶ χρόνῳ ᾧ εἰσῆλθεν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς ὁ Κύριος Ἰησοῦς ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ τοῦ βαπτίσματος Ἰωάννου ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ἧς ἀνελήμφθη ἀφ’ ἡμῶν μάρτυρα τῆς ἀναστάσεως αὐτοῦ σὺν ἡμῖν γενέσθαι ἕνα τούτων

passages.text: So they proposed two men: Joseph called Barsabbas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.
passages.sermon:
The apostles needed to choose a new apostle.
They selected two men.
The first man was Joseph.
People also called Joseph Barsabbas.
People also called Joseph Justus.
The second man was Matthias.
passages.original: Καὶ ἔστησαν δύο Ἰωσὴφ τὸν καλούμενον Βαρσαββᾶν ὃς ἐπεκλήθη Ἰοῦστος καὶ Μαθθίαν

passages.text: And they prayed, “Lord, You know everyone’s heart. Show us which of these two You have chosen to take up this ministry and apostleship, which Judas abandoned to go to his rightful place.”
passages.sermon:
The disciples prayed together.
They spoke to the Lord.
They said, “Lord, you know every person’s heart.
You understand everyone completely.
Show us which one of these two men you have chosen.
Choose one man to take this ministry and apostleship.
Judas left this ministry.
Judas went to his own place.
We need someone to take his place.”
passages.original: καὶ προσευξάμενοι εἶπαν Σὺ Κύριε καρδιογνῶστα πάντων ἀνάδειξον ὃν ἐξελέξω ἐκ τούτων τῶν δύο ἕνα λαβεῖν τὸν τόπον τῆς διακονίας ταύτης καὶ ἀποστολῆς ἀφ’ ἧς παρέβη Ἰούδας πορευθῆναι εἰς τὸν τόπον τὸν ἴδιον

passages.text: Then they cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias; so he was added to the eleven apostles.
passages.sermon:
The apostles needed to choose a new member.
They had two men to choose from.
They cast lots to make the decision.
The lot fell to Matthias.
Matthias became one of the apostles.
He joined the eleven apostles.
passages.original: καὶ ἔδωκαν κλήρους αὐτοῖς καὶ ἔπεσεν ὁ κλῆρος ἐπὶ Μαθθίαν καὶ συνκατεψηφίσθη μετὰ τῶν ἕνδεκα ἀποστόλων
